# Data Source: identitynow_governance_group

Use this data source to access information about an existing Governance Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_governance_group" "example" {
  name = "Access Approvers"
}

output "identitynow_group_description" {
  value = data.identitynow_governance_group.example.description
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Governance group name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Governance group description.
- `id` (String) ID of the governance group.
- `owner` (Attributes List) List with the governance group owner. Each element contains `id`, `type` and `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))

<a id="nestedatt--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Owner ID.
- `name` (String) Owner name.
- `type` (String) Owner type.
